tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (OpenAI-style plain ground). Default ground for ink, ink-muted and accent-ink text.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: User chat bubble, citation pill, chip hover, raw-text blocks. ink and ink-muted stay above 4.5:1 here in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals and the composer. In light it equals surface, so separate it with line or shadow-card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface token. Also the fill of an owned volume and the send button (text on it = surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, captions, placeholders, inactive nav. 6:1 on surface-subtle in light, 5.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edition badge outline and the sheet grip. Decorative; the text inside carries the meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand orange (Shopee-like, but our own value). Large fills, icons, the upcoming-volume border, cover blocks. 3.4:1 on white: never small text — use accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the 'ใหม่' badge, the upcoming volume and countdown chips. Text on it = accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text: countdown 'อีก 3 วันวางแผง', ⚡ on quick chips, text on accent-soft. 5.4:1 on accent-soft in light, 8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the ONE primary button per view: ยืนยัน, ไปหน้าร้าน. Text on it = on-action (4.7:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of an action button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: verified-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of 'มีแหล่งอ้างอิง' / verified badges.

tokens.name: verified-ink
tokens.usage: Text on verified-soft; the dot inside a citation pill; a confident (≥ 0.8) confidence bar.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of needs_review badges and the review-queue header.

tokens.name: review-ink
tokens.usage: Text on review-soft (5.5:1 light).

tokens.name: review-line
tokens.usage: Dashed border on anything uncertain (confidence < 0.8, needs_review) and the low-confidence bar. 3.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the distinct_edition ('ฉบับใหม่ในแค็ตตาล็อก') badge.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft. Blue vs orange keeps 'new edition' apart from 'new volume' by lightness and hue.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind ConfirmModal and ApprovalSheet.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: text-display
styles.sample: วันนี้อยากเช็กชั้นไหน?
styles.usage: Empty-state greeting in the chat (centered, once per screen).

styles.name: text-title
styles.sample: คลังของฉัน

styles.name: text-heading
styles.sample: เล่มที่ควรเก็บต่อ
styles.usage: Section heads on the recommendation feed, sheet and modal titles.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: ฟรีเรน เล่ม 14 กำลังจะวางแผง คุณมีเล่ม 1–13 ครบแล้ว
styles.usage: Chat answers and body copy. Thai needs ≥ 1.6 line height.

styles.name: text-body-sm
styles.sample: สนพ. รักพิมพ์ · มังงะ
styles.usage: Card titles, list rows, secondary copy.

styles.name: text-label
styles.sample: ยืนยัน 5 เล่ม

styles.name: text-caption
styles.sample: อีก 3 วันวางแผง
styles.usage: Badges, meta, citation pills, nav labels.

styles.name: text-mono
styles.usage: book_id, source_id, raw_text of an announcement, diffs in the approval sheet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between volume cells, icon-to-text in pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, gap between book cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on mobile, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between chat messages, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between feed sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state top spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, volume cells, raw-text blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Book cards, options, review items, confirm summary.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: User chat bubble, modal, top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, quick chips, citation pills, the composer.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Composer and hovered cards only. Most surfaces use line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet (ApprovalSheet).

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: ConfirmModal.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the chat column (OpenAI-like reading width).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Desktop right panel: live shelf / recommendations beside the chat.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this width, split into chat | shelf panel and hide the bottom nav.

tokens.name: book-card-width
tokens.usage: Book card width in horizontal rows (cover 2:3).
